answer.rationale: Compliance forbids rollback of the security release, so rollback_release is unavailable. Circuit breaking risks shedding or failing customer writes, which violates the objective. Regional failover is unsupported by current evidence and is risky for in-flight settlement writes. Read-replica routing previously helped when dashboard reads contended with the primary, but this incident is write-path p99 under heavy settlement writes that replicas cannot take. memory_b3 is the closest analog: added headroom absorbed a write surge and kept queues stable. Adding capacity is the single intervention most likely to restore write-path availability without dropping writes. Root cause may still be patch-induced per-request work rather than pure saturation, so keep the change scoped and treat the diagnosis as uncertain.
